item1.description: We provide fair and competitive pricing for orders from traders, commercial companies, and distributors, with flexible payment terms ranging from 6 to 18 months, in cooperation with major Egyptian banks.

item3.description: We are open to showcasing the products of distributors and trading companies on our platform, provided they are original, recently manufactured, and meet the required quality standards, with reasonable and fair commissions.

item4.description: We offer complimentary technical support to our traders and commercial clients, provided they are our registered customers.

item5.title: Catalogs & Technical Documents

about.title: About Multi Gates
about.subtitle: Your reliable partner for industrial development
about.storyText: Multi Gates for Industrial Development is a leading Egyptian company specializing in the supply and distribution of high-quality industrial components. Based in Cairo, we serve as authorized distributors for over 17 internationally recognized brands, providing bearings, belts, chains, couplings, oil seals, lubricants, and other critical industrial components.
about.missionText: To provide reliable, high-quality industrial components and solutions that help our clients maintain efficient operations across all industrial sectors in Egypt and the Middle East.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted and comprehensive industrial components supplier in the MENA region, recognized for our product quality, technical expertise, and outstanding customer service.
